businesses.business: Credit reporting and workforce data services

offering_description.value: Equifax provides employment and income verification, employer compliance services, and credit and risk data. It compiles payroll, credit, and other records and delivers reports and analytics through online platforms and data integrations to employers, lenders, government agencies, and consumers.

primary_products.value: Employment and income verification reports; consumer and business credit reports and scores; risk analytics and decision software; identity verification and fraud detection tools

primary_services.value: Employment and income verification; unemployment claims administration; employment eligibility compliance; employer tax credit administration; consumer credit monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers, payroll providers, banks, mortgage lenders, insurers, and telecommunications companies; B2G: Agencies that administer public benefits and verify applicant income or employment; B2C: Consumers seeking credit reports, scores, and monitoring

end_markets.value: Human resources and payroll; banking and consumer lending; mortgage lending; public benefits administration; consumer credit and identity protection

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Employment and income checks, credit inquiries, and identity verification queries; project or contract: Employer compliance programs, enterprise data and analytics, and agency verification programs; subscription: Consumer credit monitoring and recurring access to business data and software
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses employer payroll records to verify income for lenders and agencies and administers compliance programs for employers; other: Compiles lender and public records into credit reports and scores for businesses and consumers; software / platform: Integrates credit, payroll, and identity data into decision and verification tools for businesses and agencies

geography_served.value: global: North America, Central and South America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Workforce verification and employer compliance, credit reporting and analytics, identity and fraud tools, and consumer credit monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise and public agency account teams; online: Consumer websites, business portals, and APIs that connect to customer systems; partners / resellers: Payroll and HR software providers, lending platform vendors, and credit report resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Consumer reporting and employment screening are subject to the Fair Credit Reporting Act, CFPB oversight, and privacy laws.
